title: Still Reaching
content:
We met through glowing screens and typed words
Yet something real began to grow
I never expected to care this deeply
For someone I have never held
The distance is still long and honest
But the feelings do not seem to notice
I send these poems like quiet bridges
Hoping they reach you safely

title: Across the Quiet
content:
We have never stood in the same room
Yet your voice already feels like home
I hear you laugh and something settles
The distance shrinks for a little while
I write these lines between our talks
Hoping they travel safely to you
One day the screen may fade away
And I will finally see your smile

title: Your Morning Voice
content:
Your sleepy morning voice is my favorite sound
Soft and slow like honey melting
I wait for it more than I admit
It makes ordinary days feel warmer
I love how you sound half awake
Still carrying dreams in your tone
Honey, I could listen until the morning changes
And never hurry you awake

title: Soft and Sweet
content:
Your laugh arrives before the rest of you
Brightening the edges of an ordinary call
I find myself smiling at the ceiling
As though you had walked into the room
Some joys are small enough to miss
If you are not paying attention
I pay attention when it comes to you
That is how I keep them

title: Little Things I Keep
content:
You love the cold weather and soft blankets
You talk about small joys like old friends
I notice the little things
The way you pause before you speak
I keep them in the back of my mind
And find them there on difficult days
The smallest details become dear
When they belong to you

title: The Way You Type
content:
I notice the rhythm of your messages
How some arrive quick and bright
Others come slower, more thoughtful
As if you chose each word with care
Even the pauses between texts feel familiar
Like a conversation that never fully ends
I have grown used to that quiet pattern
And it has become a comfort of its own

title: In the Quiet Hours
content:
When the day has finally gone quiet
I read your messages a little more slowly
A thought about dinner, a picture of the sky
Something small you wanted to tell me
Nothing remarkable, and that is the point
The ordinary feels worth keeping
When it comes from you
And stays with me after the screen goes dark

title: Late Hours
content:
Some nights the conversations run late
We talk about nothing and everything
Honey, your stories make me smile
Even when the day has been heavy
I imagine ordinary mornings someday
Warm light and your voice nearby
I do not rush the picture
I let it arrive in its own time

title: What Your Words Do
content:
You write poems that feel like quiet rooms
I read them twice to keep the feeling
Sweetheart, your words stay with me
Long after the messages stop glowing
I answer with my own careful lines
Hoping they carry something back to you
A little of what your poems leave behind
A little of what I cannot say aloud

title: Thoughts That Travel
content:
I think of you in passing places
At a crossing, in a queue, by a window
The thought does not ask to be followed
It simply turns up and makes me smile
Then the day gathers itself again
And carries me somewhere else
Still, a small part of it remains yours
The part I do not have to send

title: When Time Slows
content:
There are moments when time slows down
Just because your name appears on my screen
The hours between our talks feel longer
Yet the minutes we share feel full
I do not mind the waiting
It teaches me a quieter kind of patience
Distance has its own strange rhythm
And I am learning to move with it

title: The Space Between Us
content:
There is a quiet stretch of space between our voices
Miles and hours that never quite disappear
Yet somehow your words still reach me whole
Soft and clear as if you were near
I hold that distance carefully
Like something fragile and worth keeping
Time moves differently when we talk
And the space feels a little less wide

title: After the Storm
content:
We fight at times and the words grow sharp
The space between us feels heavier then
But somehow we always find our way back
Softer and a little stronger than before
I never fear the temporary silence
Because I know we return to each other
Even the hard moments teach us care
And bring us closer in the end

title: A Place in My Thoughts
content:
You turn up in the middle of my day
Between one task and the next
In the pause before I answer someone
In the song I nearly skip
I do not go looking for you
You are simply there, familiar as a window
And for a moment, whatever I am doing
Feels a little more like mine

title: You in Soft Light
content:
There is a gentle way you exist in my mind
Like morning light through half open curtains
I notice the care in your smallest messages
The warmth that lingers after we talk
I do not need to name every feeling
I only know the days feel kinder with you
Whatever grows between us stays welcome
I hold it lightly and with quiet joy

title: The Shape of Care
content:
Care has taken a gentle shape in me
It looks like waiting for your messages
It sounds like your voice on tired evenings
It feels like wanting your days to be kind
I do not try to name it too loudly
I simply let it live where it is
Time will decide what grows from it
I am willing to let time decide

title: Soft Enough
content:
I do not need you to feel the same way yet
I only need the space to care honestly
My feelings are steady and unforced
They do not ask for more than you can give
I love the person who answers my calls
Who writes poems and shares her days
That is enough for now
And enough still feels like a lot

title: Between Here and There
content:
There are days I wish I could be nearer
Close enough to borrow your afternoon
And hear the small stories as they happen
Instead, I wait for your name to appear
And bring you the pieces of my day
A thought, a question, something I saw
It is not the same as being there
But it is a way of reaching

title: Quiet Possibility
content:
There are soft thoughts that visit sometimes
Of shared mornings and familiar silence
They live quietly without needing answers
I never push them into the light
I simply let them rest where they are
Warm and unhurried inside me
Some things grow best when left alone
I am content to let them be

title: Almost Close
content:
Sometimes I imagine the day we meet
How strange and soft it might feel
To finally hear your voice without a screen
To see the expressions that match your words
I do not rush that picture forward
I only let it sit gently in my mind
Hope is patient when it is real
And this hope feels real to me

title: What Stays
content:
Even if the future stays unwritten
Even if we only ever remain voices
I will still be glad we found each other
In this strange and glowing world
Your presence has already changed my days
Made them softer and more aware
That is a gift I will keep
No matter how the story turns

title: A Soft Promise
content:
I cannot promise what the years will bring
Or give a name to every feeling
I can meet you here with honesty
And leave room for you to be yourself
I can keep these poems free of certainty
Except for this: I am glad I found you
Whatever shape the future takes
You have made this one more beautiful
